steps.description:
Only a Function with Allow Sign-Ups ticked accepts one; anything else refuses to save.

Pick a Function to continue.
steps.label: The Function
steps.title: The Function

steps.description: One sign-up per person per function. A Church User's own Person record is forced in here on save, so only a manager can sign somebody else up.
steps.label: Who Is Signing Up
steps.title: Who Is Signing Up

steps.description: Ticked, this writes a Signed-Up row into the Function's own attendance table; unticking it takes the row back out. Attendance is never kept in two places.
steps.label: Attendance
steps.title: Attendance

steps.description: The items offered here are the ones configured on the Function itself. Put what this person will bring in My Quantity; Quantity Needed shows the target and counts everyone's contributions, not just this row's.
steps.label: What They Are Bringing
steps.title: What They Are Bringing
